 We're officially two weeks out from Black Friday. So as you're doing all the preparations for Thanksgiving, the Mashable shopping team is hunting all of the best Black Friday sales . Yes, we know that Black Friday 2026 doesn't technically start until Nov. 27, but most retailers have already launched their sales.
 As of this writing, we've found huge $200 discounts on MacBook Air laptops , a new all-time low price on Nothing headphones , and 50% savings on award-winning QLED TVs, not to mention new low prices on Legos. We just spotted a great deal on a Lego Icons Poinsettia for some holiday decor that will never wilt.
 So, if you don't want to wait for Thanksgiving to get your hands on the best gifts of the year , retailers like Amazon, Walmart, and Best Buy already have plenty of early deals to entice you. And in a year of relentless price hikes , it's nice to finally get some relief.
 How do we choose the best deals? The Mashable shopping team has an encyclopedic knowledge of the latest tech gadgets, gifts, and trending products. We use insider knowledge and our years of experience covering sales to find the best discounts. We're looking for first-ever price drops on new products, steep markdowns on past-gen products, and record-low prices on must-have items from Apple, Ninja, Shark, Dyson, and Lego.

 Frequently Asked Questions
 When is Black Friday in 2026?
 This year, Black Friday falls on Nov. 27. While retailers often start featuring their best markdowns on Black Friday itself, there are plenty of early deals worth shopping in the lead-up. Most retailers' official sales do start before the actual day, so shopping strategically ahead of time can save you from missing out on a deal entirely (or dealing with the chaos the day after Thanksgiving). 
 Will Amazon have Black Friday deals? 
 The mega-retailer just wrapped up its  October Prime Day sale , but naturally, it's also getting in on the Black Friday action. While Amazon hasn't released official sale dates yet (it's still in the final days of the  Holiday Beauty Event ), last year's Black Friday sale started over a week before the official day. As soon as we have available dates for Amazon (and other retailers), we'll update this guide. Speaking of...
 When do Black Friday 2026 sales start?
 Amazon : While no official dates are available just yet, 2025's Black Friday sale started on Nov. 20 — eight days before Black Friday on Nov. 28. 
 Best Buy : Like Amazon, Best Buy hasn't announced any official dates yet, but has promised a return of the day-after-Thanksgiving sale with some of the best tech prices of the year, plus a new batch of deals dropping on Cyber Monday. Most deals will be available online and in-store, with some exclusive to in-store sales. Following past precedent, Best Buy will also drop special deals through November, in the lead-up to the sale. 
 Walmart : Walmart has three major sale events throughout November: the early Black Friday sale from Nov. 12 to Nov. 15 , the Black Friday sale from Nov. 23 to Nov. 29 (with deals online only from Nov. 23 to Nov. 26), and the online-only Cyber Monday sale from Nov. 30 to Dec. 2 .
 Target :  Target hasn't released its full Black Friday lineup yet, but we do know its first Early Black Friday sale kicks off Nov. 5 to Nov. 7 . From  Nov. 1 to Dec. 24 , Target's Deal of the Day offer kicks off, featuring new deals every day. Every weekend after Nov. 7, the retailer will also drop new limited-time holiday offers.
